title: Netek profile
description: One person's details, used to fill a Netek cancellation request. Stored at ~/.claude-plugins/netek/profiles/<name>.json — never in this repo.

accountType.description: Selects which identity fields are required.

firstName.description: Private accounts. Letters, hyphen and space only.

personalID.description: Israeli ת.ז. Must also pass the check-digit test; validate with scripts/netek.py check-id.

contactName.description: Business accounts. Becomes fullName on the wire.

city.description: Hebrew city name. Resolve with scripts/netek.py city.

zip.description: Optional. Postcode from the street lookup. Leave empty rather than guessing.

phone.description: Contact number. The hyphen is required by Netek's validator.

email.description: The activation link is sent here. A typo makes the request unactivatable.

cc.description: Last FOUR digits of the payment method. Never a full card number.
